card.name: Inside dotted abbreviations and numbering
card.fires_on: Pieces just before a period inside dotted sequences, mostly the "i" in "t.i.d." after a dose, and also section numbers, phone numbers and dot leaders. The next character is expected to be a period.

modes.label: Dosing abbreviation t.i.d.
modes.description: The "i" in t.i.d. or b.i.d. right after a mg dose.

modes.label: Outline and section numbers
modes.description: Digits or letters in numbered outlines or section references, followed by a period.
modes.example: under the conditions outlined in section XI<<.B>>.4.b. X. UVA

modes.label: Phone numbers and dot leaders
modes.description: Digits in dotted phone numbers and runs of dots in tables of contents or tables.

card.writes: It promotes tokens that begin with a period, so it pushes the next character toward a period or dotted continuation.
card.plain: It notices when a dotted abbreviation or number such as t.i.d. is mid-way and another period should follow.
